title: When the Yearbook Breaks
author: Casper Fairweather
blurb: Silas Thackeray, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
